summary: Phase 149O.20L.7O.2E -- HATP Hardware Credential Enrollment Contract Freeze + Trust-Enrollment Implementation Plan. FINAL DISPOSITION: HHCE-001 CONTRACT FROZEN + TRUST-ENROLLMENT IMPLEMENTATION PLAN READY FOR INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION. Contract-freeze-plus-implementation-plan-only phase; zero Dell mutation, zero production .py bytes modified. Entered with HPSE-001 v1.1 (74 requirements, both former Blocking findings B-149O.20L.7O.2D.1-1/2 independently confirmed closed at contract-repair boundary by 149O.20L.7O.2D.3), HBDC-001 v1.2, RepositoryIdentity 0107866f-af7c-40b4-8317-74e71acb05ca independently verified, DeploymentBinding absent, Protected Root empty. Read directly this phase, before authoring anything: hatp_hardware_credentials.py (read-only registry, no writer, HardwareCredentialRecord's exact 5-field schema), hatp_fido2_provider.py and hatp_piv_provider.py (both credential_identity() method bodies confirmed a single unconditional raise HATPProviderUnavailableError, independent of device presence), hatp_providers.py (HATP_HARDWARE_PROVIDER_V1 sole profile, provider factory/discovery), hatp_bootstrap.py (PrincipalRecord/SignerRecord schemas, PrincipalRecord's disclosed no-revoked_at gap), hatp_deployment_binding_admin.py (the closest existing writer precedent -- atomic-write idiom, read-back verification, fixed-name flock lock, preview quartet, audit ordering, all reused not reinvented), human_approval_trusted_provenance.py (confirmed verify_hatp_proof never imports the hardware-credential registry directly -- only a concrete provider's own verify() does), and HPSE-001 v1.1's full 52-section text (particularly its v1.1 repair amendment, sections 27-48, which already bound nearly every architectural decision HHCE-001's own correctness depends on). Authored docs/contracts/HATP_HARDWARE_CREDENTIAL_ENROLLMENT_CONTRACT.md -- HHCE-001 v1.0, 52 requirements (HHCE-REQ-001..052, mechanically reconfirmed sequential, no gaps, no duplicates), the writer contract for hardware-credentials.json HPSE-REQ-053/054 name as a required prerequisite. Schema: HardwareCredentialRecord's existing 5 fields reused unwidened, plus one new field this contract adds -- revoked_at: Optional[str] -- closing NBF-2 (149O.20L.7O.2D.3's finding that HPSE-REQ-054 did not freeze HardwareCredentialRecord revocation-timestamp semantics); identical _require_revoked_at_consistency discipline and the identical strict HBDC-REQ-067/HPSE-REQ-052 timestamp grammar, no new grammar invented. Storage: canonical path is hatp_hardware_credentials.py's own existing fixed production root, no alternate path invented. Writer API: register_credential/revoke_credential plus a preview pair -- the exact HPSE-REQ-054 minimum, idempotent registration, fail-closed conflict, never reactivating a revoked record. Locking: new .hardware-credential-transition.lock (fcntl.flock, 0o600, blocking exclusive), HPSE-REQ-057's outer/inner lock-ordering rule (hardware-credential-store lock outer, .deployment-binding-transition.lock inner) restated as this contract's own obligation. NBF-1 closed directly: HHCE-REQ-037 states, as one explicit sentence, that once enroll_signer acquires both locks they remain held continuously from the HPSE-REQ-056 precondition check through registry write, read-back, and commit classification, with no release/reacquire between check and write -- previously only cross-derivable from HPSE-REQ-057 against HPSE-REQ-058(C). Cross-registry invariant (HHCE-REQ-039..041) and revocation semantics (HHCE-REQ-042..044, explicit non-cascading disposition -- live verification-time re-checking, already implemented and unchanged, is the security-relevant checkpoint, mirroring HPSE-REQ-067/069's identical rationale) both restated symmetrically from the credential-registry side. Error vocabulary (10 named conditions), audit discipline (separately attributable event types, disclosed audit-after-write-failure limitation reused from hatp_deployment_binding_admin.py, not re-litigated), runtime neutrality, and a full HHCE-REQ-052 security-boundary threat-model section all frozen. Authored the companion Trust-Enrollment bundled implementation plan (docs/PHASE_149O_20L_7O_2E_HATP_HARDWARE_CREDENTIAL_ENROLLMENT_CONTRACT_FREEZE_TRUST_ENROLLMENT_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md), naming Surfaces A (selected-provider credential-identity implementation) through E (DeploymentBinding producer cross-validation) as one coherent future implementation phase per the speed-oriented strategic principle -- not fragmented, since HPSE-REQ-056's cross-registry precondition makes the five surfaces jointly implementation-ready-or-not, with no primary-architecture evidence surfaced this phase requiring a split. Selected FIDO2 as the first provider implementation over PIV in that plan (existing source readiness -- only credential_identity() is a placeholder, the rest of Fido2HardwareProvider already works; library already present as an installed extra; deterministic-testability groundwork already proven; narrow implementation scope) versus PIV (a complete structural placeholder, no PKCS#11/smart-card library present in this codebase at all). Ran a git-stash-based fast_green baseline diff before committing: baseline (stashed, entry-commit-equivalent state) 284 failed / 8048 passed / 5 skipped / 9 errors; working tree with this phase's new files present 291 failed / 8041 passed / 5 skipped / 9 errors. Node-ID set diff found exactly 2 apparent new failures, both working-tree git-status self-checks under docs/contracts/ (test_phase_149o_14...::test_git_diff_against_pre_phase_head_touches_no_src_pcae_or_contract_file, test_phase_149o_20l_7d_10...::test_no_authority_relevant_source_mutated_by_this_phase) -- both explicitly documented in their own source as best-effort working-tree-cleanliness supplements, not the sole authority, and both confirmed resolved by a post-commit fast_green re-run (0 occurrences of either node id in the post-commit failed set). The post-commit re-run itself showed exactly 2 failures beyond the 284-item baseline: test_backend_cli.py::TestBackendReviewReject::test_reject_cannot_approve_after_reject, re-run in isolation and confirmed passing (1 passed in 0.82s -- a resource-contention flake under xdist parallelism, identical category to this repository's own repeatedly-disclosed precedent), and test_phase_149o_20l_7n_1...::TestCandidateCurrentness::test_head_equals_origin_main, which asserts HEAD == origin/main and is expected to, and does, resolve once this phase's own commit is pushed (not yet pushed at the time that node ran). Zero other content-attributable new failures. Final deselected confirmation run -- ignoring the one disclosed missing-optional-'fido2'-package collection module (identical disposition to every prior phase touching this suite) and one disclosed pre-existing/unrelated HMIC scratch-tree-setup test module (9 errors, identical count in both baseline and post-commit runs, confirmed unrelated to this phase's own files), deselecting the full 286-node-id post-commit failed set (the 284-item pre-existing baseline plus the 2 explained-above items) -> 8009 passed, 5 skipped, 0 failed. This phase's own contract and plan documents are the sole content changed; no test file was added or modified this phase (a documentation-only phase). Final verdict: HHCE-001 CONTRACT FROZEN + TRUST-ENROLLMENT IMPLEMENTATION PLAN READY FOR INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION. Recommended next: 149O.20L.7O.2E.1 -- HHCE-001 + Trust-Enrollment Implementation Plan Independent Verification. See docs/PHASE_149O_20L_7O_2E_HATP_HARDWARE_CREDENTIAL_ENROLLMENT_CONTRACT_FREEZE_TRUST_ENROLLMENT_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md and docs/contracts/HATP_HARDWARE_CREDENTIAL_ENROLLMENT_CONTRACT.md for full detail.
